highlights.title: One killed, five injured in shooting at rave in Switzerland
highlights.summary: One person was killed and five others injured, some seriously, in a shooting at a rave in the northern Swiss city of Aarau, police and local media reported Sunday. A major police operation is underway at the scene, with authorities urging residents to stay away from the area.

highlights.title: Manhunt after one killed and five injured in Swiss shooting, police say
highlights.summary: A major police operation has been launched after the shooting at an event near Zurich overnight.
